import re
src = open("pyproject.toml").read()
try:
    import tomllib
    d = tomllib.loads(src)
    assert d["project"]["version"] == "1.2.0", d
    assert d["project"]["name"] == "tool", d
except ImportError:
    assert re.search(r'^version\s*=\s*"1\.2\.0"\s*$', src, re.M), src
    assert re.search(r'^name\s*=\s*"tool"\s*$', src, re.M), src
assert "1.1.0" not in src
print("ok")
